LESSON: READING 5.2.1 READING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Reading for information

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 5.2.1 Reading for information. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why are community values important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary related to the theme for information
2. respond to questions from texts for comprehension

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify vocabulary related to the theme for information
   In simple words: practise until you can identify vocabulary related to the theme for information. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. respond to questions from texts for comprehension
   In simple words: practise until you can respond to questions from texts for comprehension. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 5.2.1 Reading for information using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 5.2.1 Reading for information in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for information to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 5.2.1 Reading for information.
4. Show that you can: identify vocabulary related to the theme for information

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 5.2.1 Reading for information using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 5.2.1 Reading for information important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Surf the internet or read books with texts related to the theme,
2. Discuss the importance of each of the values mentioned from the context of the text,
3. Digital Literacy: The learner interacts with digital content when surfing the internet or reading books with texts related to the theme.
4. Communication and Collaboration: The learner contributes to group decision making when discussing the importance of each of the values mentioned from the text. Values:
5. Unity: This is enhanced as the learner strives to achieve a common goal when preparing a skit on community values and role-plays it during club activities or school events.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify vocabulary related to the theme for information
2. respond to questions from texts for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
